name: Adventure Awaits in The Secret of the Golden Key
source:
A black cat. A mysterious boy in overalls. And YOU!

It's summer break and your parents have decided to leave you with your grandparents for a week. An entire week! On a mountain, in the middle of nowhere.

Unlock strange new worlds of imagination as you explore your grandparent's mansion, and meet a cast of quirky and mysterious characters that may (or may not) be real.

Make friends and perhaps even enemies as you traverse a sea made entirely of sand, a strange, alien planet or a realm of Fae creatures that might be more trick-some than you could even imagine.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295700/Adventure_Awaits_in_The_Secret_of_the_Golden_Key/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一只黑猫。身穿工装裤的神秘少年。你呢！

暑假到了，你的父母决定把你留给祖父母一周。整整一周！山上，荒无人烟的地方。

当你探索祖父母的豪宅时，解锁奇怪的新想象世界，并遇到一群可能是（也可能不是）真实的古怪而神秘的人物。

当你穿越一片完全由沙子组成的海洋、一个奇怪的外星星球或一个精灵生物的王国时，结交朋友，甚至可能是敌人，这些生物可能比你想象的更加狡猾。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295700/Adventure_Awaits_in_The_Secret_of_the_Golden_Key/]Steam[/url]]
